description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the ResourceKey interface, representing resource identifiers with a type and path in the Eclipse Ditto model policies module.

classes.name: ImmutableResourceKey
classes.description: An immutable class that implements ResourceKey, encapsulating resource type and path, providing factory method and overriding Object methods.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableResourceKey instance with validation.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on resourceType and resourcePath.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on resourceType and resourcePath.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string combining resourceType and resourcePath separated by a delimiter.
